objective: Align Seed Pod P0 documentation with the checkpoint and approved root-centered plan. Clarify shipped versus still-unverified behavior, keep P1 federated retrieval out of scope, preserve the promotion flow, and repair documentation indexes or audit entries only where P0 changed them.

project_context.project_type_and_purpose: Memory Seed is a local-first Markdown authority for file-reading agents. Its documentation lifecycle separates roadmap plans, draft specifications, current audits, and historical evidence.
project_context.relevant_subsystem: Seed Pod P0 introduces governed nested runtimes, root summary promotion with exact pod decision sources, lifecycle preservation, safe update transactions, diagnostics, and maintained fixtures.
project_context.task_fit: The checkpoint already edited the P0 plan, boundary spec, Todo indexes, docs root index, functionality audit context, and changelog. This branch owns their consistency and status language only.
project_context.downstream_use: The orchestrator will compare these docs with reviewed implementation branches, then run documentation, link, topic, and diff checks before requesting any integration decision.
non_goals: Do not edit production code, tests, fixtures, memory control files, ADRs, or P1 behavior; merge; push; release; or claim unrun verification.

output_contract: Write .superpowers/sdd/seed-pods-p0/documentation-report.md with status, base/head SHAs, commits, changed files, exact validation outcomes, discrepancies resolved, and residual claims awaiting integrated verification.
Keep the supplied Mermaid promotion flow compact and semantically aligned with direct active-descendant promotion to the governing root.

Include a packet-effectiveness assessment covering authority fidelity, useful and irrelevant evidence, every extra retrieval hop, missing or stale context, instruction compliance, and compiler/dispatch recommendations.

acceptance_observables.name: documentation-checks
acceptance_observables.command: python -X utf8 -m memory_seed.cli docs check; python -X utf8 -m memory_seed.cli docs index --check; python -X utf8 -m memory_seed.cli links check
